cause_quote: The diff added a focusable `<button>` labeled `${t("chat.questions.answer")}` inside `<div class="chat-question-summary" role="status">`, whose status role is implicitly a polite live region.
user_saw: Screen-reader users could hear the Answer or Retry button announced again when the async question card updated.
summary: The fix gives the question summary, delivery status, and delivery error their own live regions and puts Answer and Retry outside them.
reasoning: I checked #153849 and its parent: the summary previously contained only text, and the new Answer action shipped inside its live region. #154486 later put the new Retry action inside the same region, and the Solid port preserved both placements. The fix evidence confirms the live-region ancestry in Chromium’s accessibility tree without a recording of screen-reader speech.
